not_a_claim: PoB outputs for the seed export with forced Power Charge counts. Inputs to the flicker_sustained_v1 computation, not a benchmark result and not a measurement.
build: docs/evidence/P09-T01.1/seed/export-flicker-main.xml (seed export, Flicker Strike group 6 as main skill, imported config)
procedure: power_charges 0: config usePowerCharges unset (the imported state); PoB reports PowerCharges 0
power_charges 1 to 5: build.configTab.input.usePowerCharges = true, overridePowerCharges = n, BuildModList, recalc
overridePowerCharges = 0 with usePowerCharges = true is read by PoB as maximum (observed: PowerCharges 5), so it is not used for the 0 row
Charged Staff rows: socket group 11 disabled with ProcessSocketGroup, then the same procedure; restored afterwards
Whirling Assault row: build.mainSocketGroup = 8, recalc, read outputs; main group restored to 6
After each capture the imported state was restored and TotalDPS read back as 1048349.8862892
observations: AverageBurstHits = 1 + 2 x charges in every row, as act_int.lua FlickerStrikePlayer preDamageFunc sets it.

With Charged Staff enabled, per-strike AverageDamage rises with the forced charge count (126632 at 1, 136232 at 5); with it disabled it is flat (124231). PoB applies Charged Staff's per-charge added lightning and Flicker Strike's per-charge strikes from the same RemovablePowerCharges (gap-p09-t011-charged-staff-shared-charges).

The 0 row's per-strike damage (112388) is lower than the 1 row's even with Charged Staff disabled (124231), consistent with the seed's 'if you've consumed a Power Charge Recently' passives; not traced further.
